$comment: Dorran, retired gate guard, at the training ring. The ring trial side quest: a combat challenge.
speaker: Dorran

hello.text: Hm. Courier. Soft hands, soft boots. You'll be wanting the training dummy. It doesn't hit back.

again.text: Back for more? The pens are full.

offer.text: I kept a few of those ash-bound things in the pens, for practice. Beat everything I let out and you can have my old sword. Interested?

tips.text: Lock on. Watch for the wind-up: when they glow and that ring closes, roll through it or get your shield up. Then hit them while they're recovering.

start.text: Into the ring, then. Don't die. It's bad for my reputation.

reward.text: Well. You're less soft than you look. Here: my old Tempered Blade. Bram put an edge on it you could shave with. Don't shave with it.

done.text: The pens are empty and my sword's on your back. Go and do something useful with it.

lit.text: Don't look at me like that. It's the smoke from the forge. ...Fine. Forty years I guarded that gate, and I never once saw the Hearth burn like that. Thank you, courier.

lit_end.text: Now go and sit by that fire. You've earned it.
